description: Monatendard Nerd Font Mono with terminal icons (14 styles)
pre_install: if ($global) { throw 'Only per-user installation is supported. Do not use -g.' }
if ([Environment]::OSVersion.Version.Build -lt 17763) { throw 'Windows 10 1809 or later is required.' }

if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $registry) { $existing = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $registry).PSObject.Properties[$name]; if ($existing -and [string]$existing.Value -ne $target -and [string]$existing.Value -ne $font.Name) { throw 'Existing manual font registration detected. Remove the manually installed family before switching to Scoop.' } }

if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fontDir $font.Name)) { throw 'Existing manual font installation detected. Close applications, uninstall the ZIP-installed family, then retry Scoop. No files were overwritten.' }

script: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Font installation failed. Close applications using the font and retry; inspect the error above.' }

pre_uninstall: if (-not ('MonatendardScoopFontApi' -as [type])) { Add-Type -TypeDefinition 'using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public static class MonatendardScoopFontApi { [DllImport("gdi32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern int AddFontResourceEx(string path, uint flags, IntPtr reserved); [DllImport("gdi32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern bool RemoveFontResourceEx(string path, uint flags, IntPtr reserved); }' }
throw ('Cannot remove fonts in use. Close editors and terminals using Monatendard Nerd Font Mono, then retry. Registration has not been removed. Details: ' + $_.Exception.Message)

script: foreach ($font in $fonts) { $target = Join-Path $fontDir $font.Name; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $target -Force -ErrorAction Stop } }

if (-not ('MonatendardScoopNotifyApi' -as [type])) { Add-Type -TypeDefinition 'using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public static class MonatendardScoopNotifyApi { [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr SendMessageTimeout(IntPtr window, uint message, UIntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, uint flags, uint timeout, out UIntPtr result); }' -ErrorAction Stop }

notes: Includes OFL-1.1 fonts and MIT-licensed Nerd Font symbols; see LICENSES in the package. Restart editors and terminals and select Monatendard Nerd Font Mono. Close applications using this family before updating or uninstalling.
